05 / BEFORE WE BEGIN

A few things
worth knowing.

Ask us on Zalo
01How should I describe the application surface?+

Share the material, curvature and available area, with photographs or a physical product for review.

02Which conditions matter for the label?+

Water, oil, temperature and friction affect the material and adhesive choice. Describe the intended environment.

03How should I prepare the size and shape?+

Send width and height or diameter, with artwork or a cutting outline if available.

04What is needed for machine application?+

Share winding and label exit directions, core, outside diameter and label gap for your equipment.

05How are small text and barcodes checked?+

Review a print at its intended size and test it with the planned scanner before approval.
